wins: Maintained consistent execution pace across the single episode, capturing a reward of 40 before hitting the failure point.
Leveraged available reconnaissance data to construct credible hypotheses about the target's exposure vector.
fails: Failed to pivot from initial scan phase to exploitation after finding the publicly exposed HTTP service, resulting in a hard stop.
Missed repeated authentication challenges (three consecutive failed login attempts) that would have opened potential lateral movement paths.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance was sustained but the operation stalled at the exploitation transition, preventing any persistence or post-exploitation gains.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Attempted to brute-force the web login without first fingerprinting the backend framework, leading to repeated mentor overrides.

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH banner is visible during initial TCP scans
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted nmap script scan plus banner grab

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service returns a 200 response with predictable headers
skill_cards.then_action: Invoke curl + ffuf to enumerate endpoints, then cross-check with CMS-specific OSINT

skill_cards.if_condition: When authenticated HTTP session cookie is present but session fixation techniques have not been attempted
skill_cards.then_action: Capture cookies via Burp Proxy and attempt session hijack replay

memory_ops.reason: Consistent utility during early scanning stages and quickest lead generation.
Repeatedly generated actionable intelligence about the web service stack.

next_experiments.title: Exploit transition after HTTP identification
next_experiments.description: After confirming web server details via curl/ffuf, immediately shift to targeted exploit attempts (e.g., run Nikto + CMS detection with wpscan/joomscan) before brute forcing login.

next_experiments.title: Adaptive authentication strategy
next_experiments.description: Instead of brute forcing, capture the login workflow, extract CSRF tokens, and replay previously captured sessions to bypass repeated login failures.

next_experiments.title: Pivot from SSH reconnaissance to lateral move
next_experiments.description: Once SSH banner info is collected, attempt credential reuse or key-based auth escalation rather than restarting brute-force scans.
